findings.text: _record_decided_units discards the decision when no reviewing_sections block is active (holder is None), so a direct caller of the public review_scope(..., sections=[...]) composes a brief scoped to those sections and stores a sidecar with no traced_units, which _traced_units reads as whole-plan coverage (plan_review.py:3501: 'if not traced or unit in traced'). Every production path is safe today because crew_dispatch_commands.py:3128 wraps the composition, but the public sections parameter now has no effect on what the record claims, and the error runs in the unsafe direction: a record that over-claims coverage lets a section the round never traced pass the review gate. The prior review's finding was the same latent-caller family with the opposite direction, so this repair moved the asymmetry rather than closing it. Returning the decided units from review_scope instead of side-effecting them, or having a direct call establish its own holder, removes it.
